question: Should this umbrella continue tracking native Linux and Windows companion apps in the OpenClaw repository, or should platform app work be split into separately owned platform deliverables?
rationale: The request is broad platform product work with security, packaging, and ownership implications; the provided discussion shows multiple approaches but no completed local evidence pass.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the coordination point until accepted Linux and Windows app work is split or completed.

options.title: Split into platform items
options.body: Create or identify narrower Linux and Windows companion app issues or PRs and close this umbrella only after the split preserves the useful context.

options.title: Move out of core
options.body: Route companion apps to external app/plugin ownership if maintainers decide OpenClaw core should not own desktop app surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Continue using this issue as the coordination point until accepted Linux and Windows app work is split or completed.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided discussion shows steipete opened the issue and provided the product-direction comments.
